text:
maya: Heads-up — saw a perf delta on today's int8 canary roll. p50 looks fine but p99 for seq=512 workloads jumped ~12%. Observed on a few canary shards.
ravi: Yikes. Any recent changes to kernel selection or batching heuristics? pinging @alex for context.
alex: I merged r/4227 yesterday — it tweaks kernel selector to prefer pack-aligned int8 kernels when kv-cache hit rate > 0.6.
ci-perf-bot: Benchmark alert: int8_seq512_p99 increased +12.3% on commit 4227a1f. Full report: https://bench.redwood/4227a1f
jen: Maya, can you attach a quick flamegraph or perf capture from one of the affected nodes so we can see the hot path?
maya: pasted short profile snippet from canary-03:
```
hotloop: 45% dequant + memcpy
kv_lookup: 12%
kernel_dispatch: 8%
other: 35%
```
Looks like dequant + extra copies spiked compared to baseline.
ravi: Hmm — why would a kernel selector change increase dequant cost? Seems orthogonal.
alex: The chosen pack-aligned kernels assume an int8->fp32 dequant in-place isn't available when KV-cache present, so codepath does an explicit dequant+memcpy before dispatch. That extra copy is the regression. I missed the kv-cache interaction in the selector logic.
samir: Can you reproduce by reverting r/4227 locally and running the perf sweep?
alex: I reverted and ran perf-sweep.sh on a matching canary image. p99 returned to baseline within noise. So revert looks promising.
jen: OK let's do a narrow bisect for the exact diff inside 4200..4227 to find the line that forces the copy. Also we should add a micro-benchmark for seq=512 with high kv-hit ratio to CI.
maya: Opened PR to revert the selection change + add the micro-benchmark test: PR #5312. Putting the canary rollout on hold.
ravi: Good call. Also can we add a telemetry flag in kernel selector to emit chosen_kernel, kv_hit_rate, and whether dequant-copy was required? That would make root-cause tracing much cheaper next time.
alex: On it — I'll add a telemetry toggle behind a runtime flag and update the selector docs to document the tradeoff (pack alignment vs extra dequant copy).
ci-perf-bot: Staging perf job queued for PR #5312 (runs: int8_seq512_hot_kv).
jen: If CI perf looks good and smoke tests pass, schedule a canary rollback at 15:30 UTC and promote the revert patch with the new telemetry.
maya: ack :thumbsup:
